rule: Reject a monolithic exercise/feedback mode that collapses independent dimensions.
Reject universal one-attempt, unlimited-attempt, always/never reveal, and universally immediate/delayed feedback rules.
Reject correctness-only feedback as the universal formative default.
Reject deriving score, mastery, rank or learning from structural completion.
Reject inferring attention, effort, ability, difficulty, struggle, expertise, engagement, disability or motivation directly from attempts, time, delay, interruption or navigation.
Reject public learner, author or reviewer ranking in the first active taxonomy.
Reject probabilistic or generative assistance as sole authority for consequential scoring, approval or publication.
Reject a universal mastery threshold or fixed number-correct rule.
Reject universal hard gates without remediation, override and appeal.
Reject a single learner-control setting or unlimited control as a universal default.
Reject universal interleaving or one universal spacing schedule across domains.
Reject worked-examples-only progression without independent practice.
Reject automatic scaffold fading or adaptation based on unvalidated estimates.
Reject unbounded mandatory review queues and punitive deferral in personal study.
Reject hidden adaptation without visible target, reason, effective-state record, override and rollback.
Reject accessibility as a disableable option and reject forced public disability disclosure for ordinary access.
Reject assuming alternative modalities preserve the construct without review.
Reject AI as universal teacher, final editor, publisher or consequential evaluator by default.
Reject treating fluent, cited or AI-reviewed output as verified.
Reject unbounded context retrieval and indefinite retention of prompts, chats or intermediate reasoning.
Reject silent provider/model substitution or silent degradation to unavailable/lower-quality AI.
Reject mandatory AI assistance in the baseline study path.
Reject collection of all technically possible events by default.
Reject one dashboard and one visibility policy for all roles.
Reject treating pseudonymisation as anonymisation.
Reject indefinite identifiable-data retention for unspecified future use.
Reject treating Caliper, xAPI or another external standard as the complete ARA model.
Reject reuse of operational logs as educational analytics without purpose and authorization.
Reject opaque predictions for punitive or high-consequence decisions.
Reject one agent acting as author, auditor, approver and publisher without explicit independent authority.
Reject cross-workspace/course access inferred from chat memory.
Reject treating schema validation as pedagogical audit or audit as proof of effectiveness.
Reject review processes that modify content while presenting themselves as independent audits.
Reject silent mutation of published/research-locked artifacts and automatic propagation to consumers.
Reject free-text tags as the sole dependency, provenance or annotation mechanism.
Reject deletion of referenced or published content without impact, tombstone and retention review.
Reject applying one package license while concealing incompatible or excluded third-party materials.
Reject one score that collapses accuracy, pedagogy, accessibility, licensing and policy.
Reject LLM-as-judge as a substitute for qualified expert review in high-risk content.
Reject one global administrator role for all workspaces and capabilities.
Reject database/storage concepts as the primary vocabulary for nontechnical users.
